summary: kaniko2 takes trackingTag:. Without it, the label is derived as the destination whose build series holds every other one, and a lone bare build number is labelled `latest`. kaniko2 refuses any destination that is neither the label nor in its Ruling-D2 series, and any bare-number label; covered by the new TrackingTagTest. All 30 estate callers surveyed still resolve; only SSEGateway's lone `<n>` changes label, from `<n>` to `latest`.
